Export Secure Backup
Full software + all modules data + salary sheet/local storage secure backup generate hoga. Import karte hi sara record auto restore hoga.

Sirf valid SKAP secure backup file accept hogi. Wrong/edit backup upload nahi hogi.

Storage Rule: Data only selected location par save hoga. Jab tak location set nahi hogi, koi bhi entry save nahi hogi.
Master Panel
One Click All Data Delete
Master login se sabhi module records, reports, DD, ledger, invoice, GST, tasks, notices aur activity data delete hoga. Login users/settings safe rahenge.
🔐 Login ID / Password & Master Panel Password Change
Blank field chhodne par purani value same rahegi. Save karne par next login me naya Login ID / Password apply hoga. Master Panel Password se Master Panel open, edit aur delete protection chalegi.
Master Login active hone par hi ye setting save hogi.
